e.title: CoMoMo
e.summary: 堆叠回归集成死亡率预测 R 包：Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic 元学习器组合 GAPC 模型
e.body: CoMoMo（R 包，SSRN 论文《Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles》配套代码，被 The Actuary 报道）用堆叠回归集成（stacked regression ensemble）组合多个随机死亡率模型的预测：基于 [[stmomo]] 的 GAPC 模型族（LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT），用 Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/弹性网等元学习器在交叉验证元数据上学得动态权重，再外推组合预测。对 RIAA：长寿/死亡率预测的进阶方法——组合多个模型以降低单一模型偏差；与 [[mortalityforecast]]（方法对比框架）、[[mortalitylaws]] 同属死亡率建模工具箱；关联 [[longevity]]、[[longevity-risk]]（年金/养老场景）。
e.verified_note: raw README+SSRN 论文核实：堆叠回归集成死亡率预测（Kessy 2021, SSRN 3823511），9★ 学术背书入池
e.summary_en: R package for mortality forecasting with stacked regression ensembles: Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic metalearners combine GAPC models
e.summary_hk: 堆疊回歸集成死亡率預測 R 包：Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic 元學習器組合 GAPC 模型
e.body_en: CoMoMo (R package, companion code to the SSRN paper "Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles", featured in The Actuary) combines the forecasts of several stochastic mortality models via stacked regression ensembles: starting from the GAPC family in [[stmomo]] (LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT), Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic-net metalearners learn dynamic weights on cross-validated metadata, then extrapolate the combined forecast. For RIAA: an advanced method for longevity/mortality forecasting — combining models to reduce single-model bias; with [[mortalityforecast]] (method comparison) and [[mortalitylaws]] it forms the mortality-modelling toolbox; related: [[longevity]], [[longevity-risk]] (annuity/pension settings).
e.body_hk: CoMoMo（R 套件，SSRN 論文《Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles》配套程式碼，獲 The Actuary 報道）以堆疊回歸集成組合多個隨機死亡率模型的預測：基於 [[stmomo]] 的 GAPC 模型族（LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT），用 Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/彈性網等元學習器在交叉驗證元數據上學習動態權重，再外推組合預測。對 RIAA：長壽/死亡率預測的進階方法——組合多個模型以降低單一模型偏差；與 [[mortalityforecast]]（方法對比框架）、[[mortalitylaws]] 同屬死亡率建模工具箱；關聯 [[longevity]]、[[longevity-risk]]（年金/退休場景）。
